verdict.rationale: Penpot ships a first-party MCP server built so external AI agents can read and act on design files, and its docs tell users to 'connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away'. That makes natural-language operation a documented product capability, but only through a user-supplied external agent and LLM, with no native in-app command interface. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations agents can perform through the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration that prompting works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away!
AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
Penpot enables plenty of AI workflows, from generating editable design structures to connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation.
